Aircall

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall
We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About The Role
Aircall is looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the technical backbone of Aircall’s Marketing and GTM organizations. You will own the architecture, integrity, and evolution of our marketing technology stack, from lead scoring/routing and attribution to workflow automation. You will be the go-to person for how our systems are built, how data flows between them, and how we make them smarter and more efficient over time.

This IC role will be the primary technical counterpart to the Director of Marketing Strategy & Operations, reporting into the RevOps organization. You will partner closely with Marketing, GTM Systems, Data Science, and Sales stakeholders. You will work with our Growth and AI Automations teams to identify, build, and ship automation opportunities across the funnel. This is a rare opportunity to be the technical architect behind a modern, AI-forward Marketing Operations function, with real ownership over technical decisions to shape the next phase of Aircall’s Marketing and GTM engine.

What You’ll Own

The technical architecture and roadmap for Aircall's Marketing technology stack, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and adjacent systems

Marketing Ops execution end-to-end: from requirements gathering to build, QA, and rollout

Lead scoring, routing, and assignment logic across Marketing and Sales — you will lead a full revamp of how leads and accounts are routed and assigned

Attribution strategy: designing, building, and maintaining multi-touch attribution models that the business trusts

Data structure and architecture decisions that affect how Marketing, RevOps, Sales, and Data Science interact with shared systems

Business outcomes & key metrics: routing accuracy, lead to pipeline conversion, marketing sourced and influenced pipeline, marketing spend efficiency,

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical decision-maker for the Marketing stack, setting standards for how systems are configured, integrated, and maintained

Design and deploy attribution models, ensuring methodology is sound, documented, and defensible to Marketing and Sales stakeholders

Own lead scoring model development in partnership with Data, covering scoring, routing/assignment, and tracking of leads end-to-end

Architect and maintain the data structures underlying lead, contact, account, and opportunity objects across HubSpot and Salesforce, ensuring clean, reliable data flow between systems

Redesign and own lead/account routing and assignment rules, partnering with Sales Ops and GTM Systems to reduce speed-to-lead and routing errors

Partner with Growth and AI Automations to identify and build automation opportunities across enrichment, workflows, chatbot/agent experiences, and intent signal capture

Act as the technical counterpart to Data Science and Systems teams on modeling, data quality, and reporting infrastructure needs

Evaluate, recommend, and implement new MarTech tools, building the business case and integration plan for each

Build scalable documentation (SOPs, architecture diagrams, data dictionaries), so systems knowledge isn't siloed

Enable Marketing to scale campaign velocity and expand self-serve capabilities across the stack

Partner directly with the Director of Marketing Strategy & Operations as a technical thought partner on stack strategy, prioritization, and roadmap

Must-Have Qualifications

HubSpot certification(s) with strong, hands-on production experience administering and architecting HubSpot at scale

Salesforce expertise with strong, hands-on production experience administering and architecting Salesforce at scale

Proven experience developing and deploying attribution models (multi-touch attribution or comparable methodologies) in a B2B or SaaS environment

Deep understanding of data structure and architecture, including object relationships, data flow, APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns between marketing and CRM systems

Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, GTM Systems, Data Science, and Sales stakeholders

Experience owning lead routing/assignment logic and related Sales-Marketing handoff processes

Comfortable operating as a technical owner and decision-maker, not just an implementer

Base salary range:: $150,000 USD - $180,000 USD

Why join us?

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits

### The Role and Responsibilities

Under the general supervision of the Senior Assistant Dean, Career Development Office, the (Senior) Administrative Assistant is the frontline professional providing administrative and technical support to students and alumni for their career and professional development. This position is the first point of contact for the Career Development Office. The person in this position will work with all members of the Career Development Office staff responsible for or supporting programming, communications, and resources. A substantive part of this position is event organization and support. This position will have regular meetings with the Assistant Dean for the Career Development Office, under whose department it is directly housed, and will be involved in other Career Office efforts and programming. Whether this position is designated as Senior will depend on the level of experience.

$25.87 - $32.31 per hour

Loyola Marymount University

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8295421160423465415?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7966995671043892796&crId=US_0US_0)

Overview

Loyola Marymount School of Film & Television (LMU SFTV) is a top-ranked film school located in Los Angeles, CA. The school is recognized for its state-of-the-art facilities and equipment, award-winning faculty, expert staff, world-renowned alumni and innovative curriculum.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Dean of Operations and Administration, the Senior Administrative Coordinator, Faculty Services for the School of Film and Television (SFTV), will serve as the primary administrative support for designated SFTV department chairs.

The Senior Administrative Coordinator will hold a critical role in enhancing operational efficiency while providing comprehensive administrative support for academic departments. This role will be responsible for maintaining in-depth knowledge of university policies, procedures, and internal practices.

**Position Specific Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

**General Duties / Daily Operations**

- Serve as a primary contact for faculty inquiries, coordinating with internal partners and central university departments as needed.

- Independently process and research routine requests; discern appropriate escalation and involvement of additional parties.

- In close collaboration with Senior Administrative Coordinators and designated administrative staff, monitor and respond to inquiries/requests within shared email inbox to assist faculty from all programs.

- Assist faculty with submitting materials and requests across university-approved platforms including but not limited classroom support, technology, custodial, maintenance, reservations, and Travel and Professional Development.

- Oversee updates and maintenance of department/program webpages and faculty profiles; ensure information is current, accurate, and accessible.

- Develop and maintain written documentation outlining internal SFTV practices and standard operating procedures specific to role, supporting the Operations Department goals and initiatives.

- Prepare agendas and take detailed minutes of select committees as designated by the Dean and/or direct supervisor, ensuring accuracy and thoroughness. Navigate confidential meetings and sensitive information with a high-level of discretion, tact and diplomacy.

- Create and maintain timelines, trackers and checklists to support projects and initiatives.

- Support dean-level priorities and overarching SFTV strategic initiatives through collaboration with the Dean's Office and SFTV leadership.

- Collaborate with Associate Dean and provide onboarding support for full-time and part-time faculty, including coordination of orientation and access to university resources.

- Collaborate with designated administrative staff to support faculty searches as needed, including assisting with postings, coordinating interviews and logistics, organizing materials or demonstrations, and arranging catering or related purchases.

- Oversee the hiring and onboarding process for student workers in accordance with university policies and Student Employment Services guidelines.

- Delegate tasks to student workers to support operations and events, ensuring assignments are appropriate to their role.

- Purchase, maintain, and track supplies and inventory.

- Maintain advanced skills in Excel, Qualtrics, Adobe Sign, and LMU enterprise business systems such as Workday, Mazevo, and PROWL to support operations.

- Perform other related duties.


**Chair Support**

- Provide administrative support to department chairs and co-chairs in departmental operations.

- Manage all resources and operations necessary to support the daily functioning of the department.

- Compile and organize information to support department chairs in evaluating priorities and identifying gaps related to course scheduling, facilitating effective collaboration with the Scheduling Analyst.

- Collect, maintain, and organize records and submissions, including syllabi, course availability, script submissions, surveys, and other materials.

- Support assessment efforts by collecting and maintaining departmental data and coordinating related logistics.

- Assist in tracking academic equipment requests and other semi-annual technology or capital related requests.


**Meetings & Events Coordination**

- Plan, coordinate, and schedule department meetings, academic events, screenings, and co-curricular programs.

- Prepare agendas, checklists, run-of-show documents, and distribute relevant materials for meetings and events.

- Arrange meetings and event logistics, including catering, hospitality, supplies, on-site support, and assignment of student workers to appropriate tasks.

- Serve as primary contact for guests and speakers.

- Advertise and promote events through university online platforms and communications channels; create invitations and manage RSVPs.


**Budget & Expense Processing**

- In cooperation with the Chair/Director, manage budget of the Department/Program

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of university fiscal policies and procedures; interpret and apply fiscal policies to ensure department/program compliance. Supervision of the Department/Program budget remains the responsibility of the Chair.

- Monitor spending within approved budget allocations while ensuring compliance with university fiscal policies.

- Identify and communicate operational or fiscal concerns to support compliance and effective oversight.

- Track, process, and reconcile departmental expenses, invoices, and P-Card transactions.


**Loyola Marymount University Expectations**

Exhibit behavior that supports the mission, vision, and values of the university. Communicate and employ interpersonal actions that model high standards of professional, responsible, accountable, and ethical conduct. Demonstrate a commitment to outstanding customer service.

**Requisition Qualifications**

- Typically a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Incumbent will be expected to continue upgrading knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to keep abreast of regulation/policy changes.

- Minimum of 4 years of advanced administrative, secretarial, and/or clerical experience, preferably in higher education support roles. University experience is preferred.

- Knowledge of academic policies, university processes, systems and platforms.

- Intermediate understanding of purchasing and finance principles is strongly preferred.

- Proficiency in office software applications (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, Zoom, etc.) and ability to learn and adapt to internal systems quickly. Experience with Workday strongly preferred.

- Proficiency with graphic design software (Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud etc.) is a plus.

- Excellent organizational skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines and simultaneous projects.

- Excellent editing and proofreading skills.

- Ability to follow organizational structure and defined processes.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to interact professionally with faculty, staff, and university leadership.

- Proven ability to work calmly and efficiently in a high-pace, high volume environment.

- Proven ability to exercise a high level of discretion, handling confidential matters with sound judgment.

- High degree of emotional intelligence.

- Commitment to supporting a diverse and inclusive work environment.

- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced academic environment.

# Senior Scheduler

$145k - $190k

Luster National

**About the Position**

We're seeking a **Senior Scheduler** to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. Your main focus will be developing, maintaining, and reporting on schedules for a portfolio of public infrastructure rebuild capital projects valued at approximately $800M, giving program leadership a clear, defensible picture of where every project stands from design through closeout.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in Los Angeles, CA.

**Responsibilities** may include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Develop critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules for rebuild capital projects and maintain them through regular updates from design through construction and closeout.
- Build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent projects, giving leadership a single view of portfolio status, critical path, and key milestones.
- Review contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules for compliance with contract requirements, and flag logic, float, and progress issues before they become delays.
- Incorporate outside schedule drivers, including community meetings, partner agency concurrent work, and funding source requirements, into project and program schedules.
- Prepare and evaluate time impact analyses and delay claims, and recommend entitlement and time extensions supported by schedule evidence.
- Perform resource loading and cost loading, and support earned value reporting.
- Produce schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and executive-level summaries, and present schedule status to management.
- Coordinate with project managers, design consultants, contractors, finance staff, and partner agencies to identify schedule risks and develop mitigation options.

**Attributes**

- Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.
- Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.
- Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
- Adapts quickly to changing priorities across a multi-project portfolio.

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in construction management, civil engineering, architecture, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- 10+ years of project scheduling experience on public capital or construction projects, including 5+ years planning and scheduling public works projects from design through construction and closeout.
- Proven ability to develop CPM baseline schedules and maintain them through regular updates.
- Experience building and maintaining an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent projects.
- Experience reviewing contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules for contract compliance, and incorporating outside drivers such as community commitments, partner agency work, and funding constraints.
- Demonstrated ability to prepare and evaluate time impact analyses and delay claims.
- Experience performing resource loading and cost loading and supporting earned value reporting.
- Track record preparing schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and executive-level summaries for management audiences.
- Advanced proficiency with Oracle Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Master's degree in construction management, civil engineering, or architecture.
- AACE Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP) or PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) certification.
- 15+ years of project scheduling experience on public capital or construction projects.
- Experience supporting disaster recovery or post-disaster rebuild programs.
- Experience scheduling projects delivered through design-build, CM/GC, progressive design-build, or other alternative delivery methods.
- Experience with Deltek Acumen Fuse, Oracle Primavera Risk Analysis, or similar schedule quality and risk analysis software.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, Oracle Cloud Analytics, or other dashboard KPI reporting software.

Charles R. Drew University of Med & Sc

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/9101752303489869314?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=354&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3253501601883782266&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Mission Driven, Community Focused** About \| Charles R.Drew University of Medicine and Science (cdrewu.edu)

Charles R. Drew University is located in the Watts-Willowbrook area of south Los Angeles and was founded in 1966 in the wake of the Watts uprising. CDU was founded to address inadequate medical care in the region and to provide equitable medical education opportunities for under-represented students.

CDU offers the only historically black Doctor of Medicine program west of the Mississippi, and is strongly invested in the local and regional community. The university leads multiple partnerships and programs to provide equitable healthcare resources in a variety of south Los Angeles neighborhoods.

**TITLE:                       SENIOR ACCOUNTS PAYABLE SPECIALIST**

**DEPARTMENT:       Finance**

JOB CODE:              SAPS

DATE:                        09/23/2026 (rev 09/29/2021)

REPORTS TO:           Controller

SALARY GRADE:        PS-5

DLSE STATUS:            NON-EXEMPT

Under the direction of the Controller the Sr. Accounts Payable Specialist will process vendor invoices, check requests and other payments to vendors, credit card companies, students and employees within the specified timeframes based on the University’s policies and procedures.

**_Essential Duties and Responsibilities:_**

- Process daily vendor invoices for payment after doing either a 3-way match (Purchase Order against prices, quantities and receipts) or a 4-way match for capital items which also requires an inventory tag sheet.
- Process daily, any check request for vendors, card companies, employees and students after verifying the completeness of needed documents to support the amount being requested for payment (invoice, card statements, e-mail communication, calculation).
- Enter and post daily the related A/P batches to the A/P accounting system.
- Daily, open and sort incoming mail from vendors.
- Reconcile vendors’ monthly statements on unpaid invoices against the A/P vendor transactions data. Coordinate with both vendors, receiving department and end user the resolution of unpaid invoices.
- Coordinate and communicate with the vendor the immediate refund of any credit invoice, taking into consideration any unpaid or expected invoices from the vendor.
- Process weekly check runs using the aging report.
- Prepare and mail/release checks accordingly based on the CFO’S approval.
- Upload electronically the daily check processed to the bank’s system.
- Void and/or re-issue checks as requested. Review and analyze any bank exception notice and respond electronically for the bank to pay the related check.
- Organize and file all related documents for all payments made.
- Assist in pulling and photocopying payment documents as required for audit or vendor activity analysis. This may include files stored off-site.
- Prepare and organize year-end filing and any need to transfer files to storage facility.
- Help colleagues for any E-Requester questions / inquiries (System Software).
- Before Thursday’s check-run, double-check which requests are urgent and needed to be paid--- follows up with the Approvers and Procurement Team.
- Does E-requester requests for both Finance and Payroll Department.
- Process Garnishment requests from Payroll Department every 2 weeks.
- Process check request for wire payments for University’s Credit Card,
- Process Positive Pay from the bank.
- Follow up to any vendors/ students/ employees any overpayments done and make sure we get the refund.
- From Student Finance and Cash Management’s team request for Credit balance to students, double-check which student’s needs to be set-up and/or update address. Emails to Procurement the request and follows-up.
- Request Procurement Team for any address update for vendors/students/employees.
- Assist any University staff/colleagues/vendors and students that need a copy of cleared check or status of a check.
- Coordinates with students/employees/vendors that are asking for their check to be picked up.
- Work on any request that the Controller/ CFO asks for (Reports/ Audit).
- Provide administrative assistance to Finance Department.
- Research and resolve various issues that may arise in processing an invoice.
- Handle replies to vendor inquiries about payments.

**_Other Duties and Responsibilities:_**

- Assist other members of the Finance Department on related matters or as may be requested by the A/P lead or the Controller.
- Perform other related duties as assigned and/or requested.

**_Qualifications/Requirements:_**

**EDUCATION:**

- Regionally accredited associate’s degree in related areas and/or equivalent of combined education and experience required.

**EXPERIENCE:**

- 3 – 5 years of work experience in Accounts Payable.
- Experience working for an educational institution is a plus.
- E experience of working using any A/P computer software.

**KNOWLEDGE/ABILITY/SKILLS:**

- Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
- Capable of meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy and efficiency.
- Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels, whether from within or outside of the University.
- Ability to deliver excellent customer service to all.
- Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word.
- Interact well with everyone, can take instructions with ease, show initiative and resourcefulness when the situation calls for it.
- Familiarity with Great Plains preferred.

**COMPLEXITY:**

- The ability to perform complex work with attention and care, including high level review, analysis, and interpretation, complex research, and preparation/presentation of complex verbal and written reports is paramount to success in this position.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

- The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
- Occasional stooping. Frequent standing. Constant walking, sitting, climbing, reaching high/low levels, finger movement, feeling, speaking clearly, hearing conversationally, and seeing far and near.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

- This position is on-site unless otherwise authorized by a manager.
- The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
- No unusual working conditions.

**MENTAL DEMANDS:**

- The mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
- Frequent variety of unrelated tasks. Constant calculating interrupted work, a variety of interrelated tasks, and use of sustained concentration, reasoning, judgment, resourcefulness, analytical ability, and ingenuity.

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:**

- Ability to work effectively with a diverse community.
- As a health professions institution of higher education, Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science seeks to protect the health and safety of the University community. As a condition of enrollment and employment, students, faculty, and staff must comply with the current CDU Covid-19 requirements as described on the CDU Covid-19 webpage.  Please visit the CDU Return to Campus website -policy/ or email the Campus Nursing Office at [View email address on ziprecruiter.com](https://jooble.org/away/9101752303489869314?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=354&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3253501601883782266&crId=US_0US_0).

Founded in 1939, Higgs Fletcher & Mack LLP is one of San Diego’s most established and respected full-service law firms. With more than 70 attorneys across 20+ practice areas, the firm provides sophisticated legal counsel to businesses, organizations, and individuals throughout California. Known for its commitment to excellence, collaboration, and client service, Higgs Fletcher & Mack combines the depth and expertise of a large law firm with the personalized attention of a boutique practice. We foster a culture of professionalism, integrity, diversity, and community involvement, giving employees the chance to build rewarding careers while contributing to meaningful client outcomes and lasting community impact.

The ideal candidate will bring at least 5 years of legal billing experience, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

- Prepare, review, and finalize client invoices in accordance with firm and client billing guidelines, including adjustments for write-downs, rate corrections, trust applications, and split billing.
- Submit invoices through electronic billing platforms, manage rejections or adjustments, and ensure compliance with ABA task/activity codes and client-specific billing standards.
- Monitor attorney time entries and expenses for accuracy and compliance; assist with collections and follow up on outstanding accounts.
- Maintain eBilling platform credentials and configurations, onboard new clients, manage rate approvals, and ensure proper matter mapping and setup in Aderant.
- Process LEDES files for structure and code accuracy, redact irrelevant content from AP invoices, and ensure billing documents are clear and professional.
- Collaborate with attorneys, staff, and client representatives to resolve billing discrepancies, submit appeals, and clarify billing narratives to avoid invoice rejection.
- Maintain billing records, generate monthly reports for attorneys and the Director of Finance, Accounting & Operations, and provide insights on trusts, AR, time/cost accruals, and matter status.

**Qualifications**

- High school diploma
- At least 5+ years of legal billing experience in a law firm environment
- Must have familiarity with billing software (e.g. Aderant, Pro Law or Elite 3E)
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work independently
- Discretion in handling confidential financial and client information
- Proficiency in software such as iManage and SQL database is preferred.

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Anticipated Base Salary:** $80,000.00 - $85,000.00

**Benefits & Perks**

- 401(k)
- Health insurance
- Dental insurance
- Vision insurance
- Employer-paid Life and AD&D insurance
- Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
- Generous Paid Time Off
- Paid holidays
- Free on-site gym membership
- Access to building lounge featuring indoor & outdoor terrace decks that include Bevi Water, Social Game Room (pool tables, golf simulator), mothers’ room and more!
- Monthly transportation allowance
- Ongoing on-site workshops & continuing education programs

**Schedule** : Monday to Friday

**Work Location:** On-site Monday-Friday until fully trained, then hybrid

# Senior Payroll Specialist (Englewood)

Location:Cherry Hills, COCompany:Lightwave Logic, Inc.

## Description:

**Lightwave Logic – Senior Payroll Specialist**

**Company:** Lightwave Logic (Nasdaq: LWLG)

**Location:** Englewood, CO - Hybrid

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Salary:** $65,000 - $100,000 plus Equity (RSUs)

**Lightwave Logic** (Nasdaq: LWLG) is a publicly traded materials development company that is conducting cutting-edge work to commercialize its proprietary organic nonlinear polymers for a variety of electro-optic devices and pushing the state of the art in high-speed fiber-optic telecom and data communications. Our development roadmap is designed to disrupt the industry by introducing organic modulators and related photonic integrated circuits that offer superior speed, lower power consumption, and smaller size compared to current technologies. Our materials are extendable into other applications, including sensors and quantum computing.

**Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Payroll Specialist to support the day-to-day accounting operations of the Company, with primary responsibility for payroll administration, stock-based compensation administration, vendor invoice processing, fixed asset accounting support, and state registration compliance activities. The ideal candidate is an accounting professional who is comfortable working across multiple accounting areas and helping build scalable processes in a growing organization.

This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively across Finance, Human Resources, and Operations functions.

**Responsibilities**

**Payroll Administration**

- Administer semi-monthly multi-state payroll processing in coordination with Human Resources and third-party payroll system providers.
- Review payroll data for accuracy, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, commissions, and benefit deductions.
- Prepare and record payroll-related journal entries and account reconciliations.
- Assist with payroll tax reporting and resolution of payroll-related inquiries.
- Maintain payroll documentation and support internal and external audit requests.

**Stock-Based Compensation Administration**

- Administer employee equity programs, including stock options, restricted stock units (RSUs), and other equity awards.
- Coordinate with the Company's equity administration platform and transfer agent as applicable.
- Process employee grants, vesting events, exercises, and terminations.
- Maintain accurate equity records and supporting documentation.
- Assist with preparation of reports supporting stock-based compensation accounting under ASC 718.
- Support quarterly and annual financial reporting requirements related to equity compensation.

**Accounts Payable and Vendor Support**

- Assist with processing vendor invoices and employee expense reports.
- Verify coding, supporting documentation, and approval requirements in accordance with Company policies.
- Monitor invoice workflows and follow up on outstanding approvals.
- Support vendor statement reconciliations and issue resolution.
- Assist with monthly accounts payable close activities.

**Fixed Assets**

- Assist with maintaining the fixed asset register and related supporting schedules.
- Support asset capitalization, transfers, disposals, and depreciation calculations.
- Coordinate periodic physical observations and inventory of fixed assets.
- Prepare fixed asset reconciliations and supporting close documentation.
- Assist with audit requests related to fixed assets.

**State Registrations and Compliance**

- Assist in maintaining the Company's state registrations, business licenses, and annual reporting requirements.
- Monitor filing deadlines and coordinate submissions with external service providers and internal stakeholders.
- Maintain compliance documentation and filing records.
- Support sales tax, payroll tax, and other state compliance initiatives as assigned.

**General Accounting**

- Prepare journal entries, reconciliations, and schedules as part of the monthly close process.
- Assist with financial statement support schedules and audit requests.
- Participate in process improvement initiatives and documentation of accounting procedures for SOX compliance.
- Support special projects and other accounting responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field preferred.

**Experience**

- 2–5 years of hands-on accounting experience.
- Experience processing full-cycle payroll required.
- Experience administering equity-based compensation programs for a publicly traded company, including stock options, RSUs, or ESPP, highly preferred.
- Experience in a public company, manufacturing, technology, or high-growth environment is a plus.
- Experience with NetSuite ERP and one of the major payroll systems strongly preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

- Strong understanding of general accounting principles and internal controls.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functions.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and confidentiality.

**Benefits**

Lightwave Logic offers a highly competitive compensation package including stock options, as well as comprehensive benefits including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage(employee and family), a generous PTO policy, $500/year(prorated) company contribution to your medical FSA, and a 401K (safe harbor, 4% match).

**EEO Statement**

Lightwave Logic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

**Company Description** Kingswood U.S. is a diversified financial services firm that empowers clients to navigate complex financial markets with confidence. The company delivers innovative wealth management, robust advisor services, and tailored investment banking solutions for individuals, families, advisors, and middle-market businesses. # Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator (Milwaukee)

Location:Saint Francis, WICompany:Potawatomi Casino Hotel

## Description:

**Pay based on experience \| First shift**

In this fast-paced, high-energy environment with multiple revenue streams and departments, timely and accurate financial reporting is critical to support informed business decisions. As a Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring the efficient execution of the accounts payable cycle while supporting the overall success of the Finance team. While carrying out the job duties listed below you will contribute to our continued success by providing unsurpassed guest service, personal, and professional dedication to our Mission, Vision, and Values, and demonstrating a high level of integrity and ethical standards.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential Functions)**

01. \*Support daily accounts payable operations by reviewing, verifying, and processing vendor invoices in accordance with established policies, procedures, and internal controls.
02. \*Coordinate invoice approval workflows and resolve discrepancies with vendors and internal departments to ensure timely and accurate payment processing.
03. \*Perform invoice matching, coding verification, and data entry within the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
04. \*Prepare and support weekly payment processing activities, including check and electronic payment methods, ensuring all required documentation and approvals are complete.
05. \*Maintain organized electronic and physical accounts payable records, including invoice support, payment documentation, and vendor files.
06. \*Review open purchase orders, receivers, and vendor statements to identify and resolve outstanding issues or discrepancies.
07. \*Assist with vendor onboarding and maintenance processes, including collection and verification of required documentation and system updates.
08. \*Support month-end and year-end closing activities through account reconciliations, accrual support, and preparation of assigned documentation and reports.
09. \*Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies within accounts payable operations and assist with implementation efforts as directed.
10. \*Collaborate with accounting and finance team members to support departmental goals, cross-training initiatives, and operational continuity.
11. Ensure all assignments are completed timely and in full compliance with departmental Internal Controls, policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
12. Perform other duties as assigned.

**Job Qualifications**

01. An Associate’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related business field and 3 years of accounts payable or accounting support experience are required. A high school diploma or equivalent with 5 years of related accounts payable experience in an organization of similar size may be considered in place of the degree requirement.
02. Working knowledge of accounts payable processes, purchasing and payment procedures, account reconciliations, and general accounting practices is required.
03. Office skills must include the ability to use standard office equipment and intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word. Experience with electronic accounting and purchasing systems is required. Experience with Red Rock Materials Management and Acumatica is preferred.
04. Must possess strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
05. The ability to review, identify, investigate, and resolve invoice discrepancies, vendor statement issues, and other accounts payable variances in a timely manner is required.
06. The ability to maintain accurate financial records and interpret reports, supporting documentation, and departmental procedures is required.
07. The ability to communicate effectively and professionally with vendors, team members, management, and other departments is required.
08. Previous lead, mentoring, or cross-training experience is preferred.
09. The ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
10. The ability to maintain discretion in handling confidential information.
11. The ability to interact with guests and team members professionally.
12. The ability to work irregular hours and extended shifts (though rare) could include late nights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays.

**Working Conditions**

The noise level is usually moderate. When on the casino floor, the noise level increases. The facility is not smoke free.

**Disclaimer**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all qualifications, responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

# >>\> Office Clerk/Assistant to Director <<<

$19 - $20 per hour

Parent Education Bridge for Student Achievement Foundation

[South El Monte, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/South-El-Monte%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3267314104854752493?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6633&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6450372848588762702&crId=US_0US_0)

**Benefits/Perks**

- Competitive Compensation
- Great Work Environment
- Career Advancement Opportunities

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an **Office Clerk/Assistant** to join our team! As an Office Clerk, you will answer the phones, direct calls, and handle customer questions. You will also be filing paperwork, making copies, faxing documents, and mailing information out to customers, as needed. The ideal candidate has excellent customer service skills, experience working in an office environment, and strong organizational skills.

The Office Clerk/Assistant to the Executive Director will directly report to and support the Executive Director, handling a wide range of administrative tasks and ensuring smooth office operations. This position requires a proactive individual with exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

**Responsibilities:**

- **Direct Executive Support:**
 - Manage and maintain the Executive Director's complex calendar, scheduling appointments, and coordinating meetings.
 - Prepare and organize documents, presentations, reports, and correspondence for the Executive Director.
 - Handle and prioritize incoming and outgoing communications, including emails, phone calls, and mail.
 - Arrange and coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, and related logistics.
 - Prepare meeting agendas, take and distribute meeting minutes, and track action items.
 - Screen and prioritize communications to the Executive Director.

- **Office Administration:**
 - Maintain organized filing systems, both physical and electronic.
 - Manage office supplies and inventory, placing orders as needed.
 - Greet and assist visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment.
 - Answer and direct phone calls, providing accurate information and handling inquiries.
 - Process incoming and outgoing mail and packages.
 - Assist with data entry, record keeping, and database management.
 - Coordinate office events and meetings, including logistics and preparation.

**Confidentiality and Discretion:**

- Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and professionalism.
- Maintain confidentiality regarding organizational matters and executive communications.

- **Other Duties:**
 - Assist with special projects and other administrative tasks as assigned by the Executive Director.
 - Assist with basic book keeping.

**Qualifications:**

- High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's or bachelor's degree preferred.
- Proven experience in an administrative support role, preferably supporting senior management.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
- Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Experience with basic book keeping is a plus.
- Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality.

**Skills:**

- Calendar management and scheduling
- Meeting coordination and minute taking
- Document preparation and editing
- Communication and interpersonal skills
- Data entry and record keeping
- Filing and organization
- Customer service and phone etiquette
- Problem-solving and decision-making
- Basic bookkeeping.

Compensation: $19.00 - $20.00 per hour

**Parent Education Bridge for Student Achievement Foundation**

**PEBSAF Family Academy: Empowering Parents, Nurturing Success**

Driven by a deep commitment to community service and quality parent education, PEBSAF Family Academy emerged in 2007, founded by a dedicated group of parents, educators, and school counselors. Recognizing the profound impact of parental involvement in a child's educational journey, PEBSAF has made it its mission to bridge the gap between home and school, empowering parents with the knowledge and skills they need to actively support their children's learning.

Inspired by the groundbreaking work of Joyce Epstein, a renowned expert in family engagement, PEBSAF's comprehensive virtual parent workshops provide a wealth of resources and guidance on a wide range of topics, from effective communication strategies to homework support and navigating the school curriculum. Through interactive and engaging sessions, PEBSAF has transformed the lives of thousands of families across the United States, empowering them to play an integral role in their children's academic success.

Research has consistently demonstrated the positive correlation between parental involvement and student achievement. A study based on data from the National Educational Longitudinal Study involving over 10,000 12th graders revealed that students whose parents actively promoted academic achievement scored significantly better on standardized tests. These involved parents engaged in regular communication with teachers, attended school events, and discussed academic progress with their children. The impact of parental involvement far outweighed other social factors at school, such as extracurricular activities, school climate, and teacher morale.

PEBSAF understands the financial constraints faced by schools and offers a cost-effective flat-fee-for-service model, eliminating hidden costs and budget overruns. This commitment to affordability, coupled with the avoidance of per-parent charges or unnecessary annual licenses, ensures that PEBSAF's programs are accessible to all, regardless of school size or budget.

Whether your school seeks a single workshop or a comprehensive series, PEBSAF Family Academy is ready to collaborate with you, tailoring our programs to meet your specific needs and budget.

Our team of experienced educators is dedicated to providing the highest quality parent education, empowering families and transforming schools into thriving learning environments where every child can reach their full potential.

**OUR COMMITMENT**

- Create a community where families take an active role in the education and future of their children.
- Reduce homelessness by helping increase the number of students who graduate with a bachelor's degree or higher.
- College success for low-income, minority, and English language learners students.

**OUR MISSION**

- Help families thrive by empowering parents with quality education and community resources to help their children thrive and reach their full potential.
- Address disparities in student achievement, college readiness, and increase the number of students who graduate from a college or university.
- Provide schools with an effective and affordable family educational program that builds relationships and collaboration in the community.
- We collaborate with other community-based organizations with a track record of serving the community. Our partners for student success provide education and resources for families in the community.

**Careers**

**Make a Meaningful Impact on Families**

Embrace your passion for education and join our growing organization of Parent Educators who are revolutionizing family engagement through innovation and creativity.

Make a meaningful difference in the lives of families.

# Office Manager - State Farm Agent Team Member

$1,000 - $2,500 per month

Jd Snead - State Farm Agent

[Rancho Cordova, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Rancho-Cordova%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7169982533108539841?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7222&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4139577838938680970&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Office Manager - State Farm Agent Team Member

Successful State Farm Agent is seeking a qualified professional to join their winning team for the role of Office Manager - State Farm Agent Team Member. We seek an energetic professional interested in helping our business grow through value-based conversations and remarkable customer experience. If you are a motivated self starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, then this is your opportunity for a rewarding career with excellent income and growth potential.

Responsibilities

- Establish customer relationships and follow up with customers, as needed.
- Provide prompt, accurate, and friendly customer service. Service can include responding to inquiries regarding insurance availability, eligibility, coverages, policy changes, transfers, claim submissions, and billing clarification.
- Use a customer-focused, needs-based review process to educate customers about insurance options.
- Work with the agent to establish and meet marketing goals.
- Develop leads, schedule appointments, identify customer needs, and market appropriate products and services.
- Maintain a strong work ethic with a total commitment to success each and every day.

As an Agent Team Member, you will receive...

- 401K
- Salary plus commission/bonus
- Paid time off (vacation and personal/sick days)
- Valuable experience
- Growth potential/Opportunity for advancement within my agency
- Hiring Bonus in the range of $1000 - $2500

Requirements

- Successful track record of meeting sales goals/quotas preferred
- Interest in marketing products and services based on customer needs
- Excellent interpersonal skills
- Excellent communication skills - written, verbal and listening
- Enthusiastic about the role insurance and financial products play in helping people manage the risks of everyday life, recover from the unexpected, and realize their dreams
- Detail oriented
- Proactive in problem solving
- Ability to make presentations to potential customers
- Achieve mutually agreed upon marketing goals
- Experience in marketing
- Ability to explain complex financial issues in understandable terms
- Property and Casualty license (must have currently)
- Life and Health license (must be able to obtain)
- Must be available to work the following schedule: Mon Thru Fri - (no weekends) - ($50,000 - $70,000)
- Bachelor's degree preferred

##### Do you want to work with someone who will help you achieve YOUR goals?

This busy insurance and financial services office has a passion to make a difference in the lives of others and better the community. We are an established, growth-oriented agency with a team of highly motivated individuals. We attribute our success to having a fun, energetic environment that is an enjoyable place to work. Our team is comprised of results-oriented individuals that are serious about their development. If you want to work in an environment that is fun, challenging, and rewarding, then Jd Snead - State Farm Agent may be the right fit for you!

##### About Our Agency

- We help customers with their insurance and financial services needs, including Auto Insurance, Home Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement Planning, and Business Insurance.
- Our office is located in Rancho Cordova, CA and Cameron Park, CA and Serve CA, AZ and OR.
- I have been a State Farm agent since 2006.
- We currently have 8 team members at our agency.
- We have 60 years of combined insurance experience in our office.
- Our agency has received awards including: Chairman's Circle, Ambassador Travel, Legion of Honor, Senior Vice President's Club, Silver Scroll, Golden Triangle, and Bronze Tablet
- Additional languages spoken: Spanish

##### Apply now and let us put you on the path to success.

State Farm agents are independent contractors who hire their own employees. State Farm agents' employees are not employees of State Farm. Agents are responsible for and make all employment decisions regarding their employees.

# Administrative Coordinator (Part Time, Night)

NorthBay Healthcare Group

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6388103868964871386?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5769869794208598635&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Description
The Administrative Coordinator (AC) is a registered nurse with demonstrated clinical expertise and supervisory experience. For a specified shift, the AC coordinates and is accountable for the administrative, clinical and ancillary activities within the hospital. The AC acts as the single point of contact for physicians, departments, nursing and administrative management team, to assist in the timely and accurate placement of patients requiring acute care admission, transfers, and all aspects of patient movement and coordination of care.

The AC has the responsibility, accountability, and the authority to manage the hospital with front line leadership, resource management and short term plan design and implementation to meet needs for delivery of patient care and staff. Holds staff accountable to adhere to standards of practice utilizing The NorthBay Way. The AC utilizes Jean Watson’s Theory of Caring, the Relationship Based Care, and NorthBay’s professional nursing practice model to promote and support a transparent and collaborative environment. The AC supports the mission, vision, values and expectation of excellence of the organization.

The AC assures the activities of the hospital are in accordance with hospital policies, procedures and standards. For a specific shift, the AC ensures compliance with and participates in the hospital’s performance improvement plan and infection control plan both as a resource and through assigned duties. Works under the supervision of the Director, Acute Care and Clinical Support Services.

Education

## QUALIFICATIONS

Graduate from an accredited school of professional registered nursing.

BSN preferred. Minimal nursing degree of BSN level required within four years of hire.

Licensure

Valid and current RN license by the State of California.

Current AHA or AHA equivalent BLS.

ACLS certification required within six months of hire.

Experience, Knowledge And Skills

A minimum of three years acute care (Hospital) experience.

Previous supervisory or management experience preferred

Excellent clinical assessment skills.

Proficient written, verbal, and electronic communication skills in the English language.

Understands policies governing admissions, unit-specific admissions, observation status and compliance.

Knowledge of EMTALA regulations

Advanced computer skills.

Ability to integrate information from multiple sources.

Excellent organization and follow-through skills.

Excellent critical thinking ability. Good problem solving ability and able to make sound decisions rapidly.

About Us
NorthBay Health is an independent, nonprofit health system serving the Napa, Solano, and Yolo County regions. We are expanding access to care across our communities through two acute-care hospitals, including a Level II Trauma Center and a Level III NICU maternity unit, along with a cancer center, urgent care locations, and a growing network of primary and specialty care clinics.

We provide advanced services in cardiovascular care, neuroscience, orthopedics, surgery, and outpatient specialties. NorthBay Health is nationally recognized for quality care, including Magnet with Distinction designation for nursing and multiple U.S. News and World Report high performing recognitions.

We are committed to being the trusted healthcare partner of choice and offer an environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and support the health of our communities.

Interpersonal Skills and Values
Demonstrates NorthBay Health’s True North Values: Nurture Care, Own It, Respect Relationships, Build Trust, and Hardwire Excellence. These values guide behavior, accountability, teamwork, and commitment to high-quality patient care.

Why NorthBay Health
NorthBay Health is an independent, nonprofit health system serving the Napa, Solano, and Yolo County regions. We are expanding access to care across our communities through two acute-care hospitals, including a Level II Trauma Center and a Level III NICU maternity unit, along with a cancer center, urgent care locations, and a growing network of primary and specialty care clinics.

We provide advanced services in cardiovascular care, neuroscience, orthopedics, surgery, and outpatient specialties. NorthBay Health is nationally recognized for quality care, including Magnet with Distinction designation for nursing and multiple U.S. News and World Report high performing recognitions.

medical, dental, and vision insurance

paid time off including vacation, sick leave, holidays, and bereavement

education reimbursement for eligible roles

professional development and training programs

Employee Assistance Program

wellness programs

recognition programs

shift differentials

market-based compensation review and increases subject to approval and organizational performance

Compensation Structure
NorthBay Health uses a structured compensation framework. Staff-level positions use a step-based system (Steps 1-5) based on years of directly related experience, with Step 5 representing 20 or more years of experience in the role. Manager level and above positions are paid a fixed annual base salary and are eligible for a variable incentive compensation plan. Physician compensation is structured based on specialty and role requirements.

Remote Work Disclosure
NorthBay Health is primarily an onsite organization due to the nature of healthcare. Some roles may allow hybrid or remote work based on business needs.

Remote work is not supported in Washington, Ohio, Wyoming, North Dakota, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, or outside of the United States.

Notice to Recruitment Agencies
NorthBay Health utilizes a managed service provider (MSP) for agency partnerships and is not currently engaging external recruiting firms outside of established agreements. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or third-party candidate submissions. Please do not contact NorthBay Health employees, leaders, physicians, or hiring managers regarding recruitment or job postings.

Mokri-Vanis-&-Jones,-LL

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

Mokri Vanis & Jones has an immediate opening for a Human Resources & Office Coordinator for our Sacramento office. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, keeping an office running smoothly, and building a career in Human Resources within a collaborative legal environment.

**Who We Are:**
Mokri Vanis & Jones, LLP provides a full range of transaction and litigation services throughout California and Nevada. We represent a broad spectrum of clients, from major multinational corporations and financial institutions to family-owned small businesses and private individuals.

**About the Role:**
The Human Resources & Office Coordinator serves as the primary HR and administrative support professional for our Sacramento office. Reporting directly to the Director of Human Resources & Administration, this position partners closely with Sacramento office leadership to support employees throughout the employment lifecycle while coordinating and supporting day-to-day office operations and ensuring a welcoming, professional workplace.

**What You’ll Do:**
This role supports the HR department by overseeing general office and facilities activities, as well as providing administrative and Human Resources support with guidance from the corporate Human Resources Leadership Team.

Requirements
Human Resources Support

Employee Relations: Assist with maintaining a positive work environment by responding to routine employee questions and directing more complex matters to Corporate Human Resources.

Onboarding & Setup: Coordinate new hire onboarding, workspace preparation, orientation, equipment set up, and 30-day follow-up activities.

Equipment & Supply Ordering: Request and order employee equipment and supplies once approvals are secured from Corporate HR, and the Finance Department.

Confidentiality: Protect sensitive employee details, records, and workplace matters with strict privacy and professionalism.

Recruiting Support: Assist with interview scheduling, candidate communications, reference checks, and other recruiting activities as assigned.

Leave Administration: Assist employees with routine leave and benefit paperwork while coordinating with Corporate Human Resources.

Culture & Employee Engagement: Assist with employee recognition activities, office events, celebrations, and initiatives that promote a positive workplace culture.

Office Administration & Operations

Office & Facilities Management: Oversee day-to-day office needs, general supplies, and facilities upkeep to ensure an organized, professional, and efficient workplace.

Vendor Coordination: Assist in the coordination of office maintenance, repairs, deliveries, and vendor access.

Front Desk Assistance: Cover the reception desk as needed to welcome visitors and manage incoming calls.

Filing & Organization: Oversee file maintenance to ensure clean physical and digital filing systems for office records and correspondence. Off-site storage as well

General Admin Support: Handle routine clerical work, administrative tasks as requested.

**Qualifications:**

2-3 years of experience in Human Resources, office administration, recruiting, or related field.

High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field is a plus

Working knowledge of California employment laws, HR best practices, and employee confidentiality requirements

Available to work in the office weekdays Monday - Friday, hours ideally 8:30 am – 5:00 pm

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Proficiency in Outlook and Microsoft products

Strong interpersonal skills

Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions

Ability to build positive working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization

Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgement, and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality

Strong organizational skills; able to manage priorities and workflow

Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm

Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace

Professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to perform diversified clerical functions and basic accounting procedures

Dependable, Excellent interpersonal skills and oral communication, and punctual.

Ability to exercise discretion when handling confidential employee and business information

Experience with HRIS systems is preferred (Paylocity experience is a plus)

## PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Frequently required to stand and walk

Occasional sitting

Frequently required to utilize hand and finger dexterity

Occasionally required to climb, balance, bend, stoop, kneel or lift

Frequently utilize visual acuity to operate equipment, read technical information, and/or use a keyboard

Occasionally lift or move office supplies and equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Deeper Than Color: Social Justice & Strength-Based Psychotherapy and Consulting

Administrative & Marketing Assistant – Deeper Than Color
Location: Remote (California Applicants Only) Position Type: Part-Time

About Deeper Than Color
Deeper Than Color is a team of highly skilled clinicians dedicated to social justice-oriented psychotherapeutic support, serving a diverse clientele. We believe healing and thriving require s acknowledging the harm caused by complex systems of oppression while embracing the strengths rooted in history and cultural heritage. Our work fosters mental freedom, happiness, and community well-being.

We offer virtual therapy, DEI consulting, and training, while expanding our group wellness coaching and corporate wellness services. As we grow, we seek a patient, professional, and highly organized individual to serve as an Administrative & Marketing Assistant, supporting both practice operations and brand outreach.

Position Overview
The Administrative & Marketing Assistant will support daily operations, manage client communications, and assist with marketing efforts to strengthen the organization's digital presence and community engagement. This role requires strong organizational skills, a commitment to social justice, and the ability to work independently in a remote setting.

Primary Administrative Duties

Provide administrative and time management support to the Founder/CEO and clinicians.

Manage practice calendars and assist clinicians with scheduling.

Conduct phone screenings and consultations with potential clients.

Schedule initial client appointments and manage correspondence.

Answer phones, emails, and social media inquiries professionally.

Perform reactive outreach via phone and email to potential clients.

Handle billing management and process payments.

Follow up with clients/customers via thank-you notes and reminders.

Maintain organized communication flow and client data reporting.

Marketing & Digital Engagement Responsibilities

Develop and execute marketing campaigns aligned with our mission.

Manage social media platforms, including content creation, scheduling, and engagement.

Support email marketing efforts and audience outreach.

Conduct market research and analyze trends to enhance marketing strategies.

Assist in maintaining and updating website content for brand consistency.

Collaborate with team members to ensure clear storytelling and messaging.

Additional Growth Opportunities (Based on Candidate's Abilities)

Research blog post topics and assist with content strategy.

Manage lists, databases, and outreach tools.

Prepare PowerPoint presentations for internal or client-facing meetings.

Transcribe audio or video content (podcasts, workshops, etc.).

Take minutes during team meetings and document key discussions.

Complete light errands such as online orders and mailing documents.

Proofread documents for typos and grammatical errors.

Make travel arrangements for business-related events.

Desired Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Excellent customer service and communication skills.

Commitment to social justice, diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Experience with medical billing (or willingness to learn).

Proficiency in Adobe Professional, Canva, G Suite, Microsoft Office, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Strong attention to detail with highly organized work habits.

Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a remote setting.

Familiarity with LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter marketing strategies.

Experience with Canva, Mailchimp, SEO, and analytics tools preferred.

Minimum Qualifications

Prior experience as an administrative assistant.

Prior experience with social media marketing.

Associate degree or enrollment in a four-year college/university.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, psychology, or a related field.

Make a Real Difference, Every Single Day
As a nonprofit leader in aging, Eskaton helps people live well, longer — with trusted guidance at every stage. We believe aging should be a vibrant,supported,and celebrated journey, not an experience to face alone. For over 55 years, Eskaton has been a cornerstone of Northern California,growinga network of 23 communities dedicated to older adults and the people who care for them. When you join us,you'renot just starting a job.You'restepping into a career where your work createsa realimpactonpeople's daily lives and strengthening the communities we call home.

We Invest in You (Because You Invest in Others)

Financial Security:Competitive pay and a 401K matching program to help you plan for your own future.

A Place Where You Belong:We celebrate diversity and equity across the entire aging spectrum, ensuring every team member feels seen and valued.

Our DNA (Core Values)

Welcoming:You’rea naturalat creating warmth and a sense of belonging for everyone you meet.

Bring (Y)our Best:You take pride in your work and strive for excellence in the "little things" and the "big things" alike.

Empowerment:Youdon'twait for permission to do the right thing. You step up, take ownership, and lead with initiative.

Growth:You’rea lifelong learner who seeks consistent improvement and sustainable growth.

Essential Job Functions

Operates multi-positioned telephone switchboard to relay incoming, outgoing and inner-office calls, and performs other tasks related to communication.

Greets visitors, determines their needs, and contacts the proper person.

Answers general questions and gives general information to those visiting or calling the community.

Performs a variety of other clerical duties, depending upon project assigned, such as: posting data from one record to another, typing reports, sorting and distributing mail and phone messages, and other related clerical duties.

Schedules and coordinates tele-conference calls.

Sorts and distributes mail and other inter-office materials necessary for community operations.

Schedules and coordinates room calendars.

Accurately completes assignments according to directions given and performs other duties as required of position.

Other Job Functions

Models and embodies Eskaton’s core values, including:

Creating a sense of warmth, welcoming and belonging for all

Fostering excellence in everything we do

Seeking consistent improvement, learning and sustainable growth

Stepping up, taking ownership and leading with initiative

Fully complies with all provisions in Eskaton’s Corporate Compliance Policy and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

Maintains attendance as outlined in Eskaton policy.

Follows required dress code and Eskaton’s Community Appearance Standards. Maintains a professional image to the public and residents.

Works in accordance with established safety guidelines; uses proper body mechanics; follows safe work practices; wears appropriate safety gear.

Compensation
Starting pay ranges from $19.40 per hour – $24.04 per hour. Factors such as scope, responsibilities, experience, education, job-related skills, internal equity, and market considerations may influence base pay.

This position shift is Friday to Monday.
Qualifications
Education: High school or equivalent G.E.D., including courses in typing required.

Training And Experience
Experience as a receptionist with public contact desirable. Experience with personal computers and related software preferred. All staff that provide direct care to residents will have current first aid training.

Knowledge And Abilities
Knowledge of telephone etiquette, interpersonal communication, typing formats for correspondence and documents, calendaring and filing.

Work Conditions And Physical Requirements
Requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Notify the Human Resources team to request any accommodation(s) to perform any of the essential functions of this position.

Light Work
Exerting up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg control requires exertion of forces greater than that of sedentary work and if the worker sits most of the time, the job is considered light work.

At Virginia Heart, we are  seeking friendly, dependable, and enthusiastic **Front Desk Medical Receptionist** to provide daily administrative and customer service support to medical office operations at our busy practice. In this critical role, the ideal candidate must have a high level of customer service experience and professionalism.

When you work with Virginia Heart, you will enjoy a dedicated and experienced staff, competitive wages, excellent benefits and the following rewards and incentives:

- No Nights, weekends, or holidays!

- Able to identify all accepted insurance plans and cards.

- Schedules appointments either via phone or in person.
- Respects and maintains patient privacy and dignity. Always adheres to HIPAA law.

- High School Diploma or equivalent required
- Minimum one year of experience in a receptionist position in a fast-paced environment
- Medical office experience in a multi-provider office preferred.
- Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus
- Computer proficient with good typing skills
- Prior experience with the use of an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) preferred.
- Excellent customer service skills and positive attitude
- Ability to multi-task
- Detail oriented
- Strong communication skills and pleasant phone manner

# Customer Service Manager

$100k - $110k

Creative Alignments

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1683256299421282055?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6419855835230792386&crId=US_0US_0)

Every grain has somewhere to be. You'll lead SunFoods' US Customer Service function, owning everything from order management and data integrity to escalations and international trade compliance.

**SunFoods**

SunFoods is a rice milling, distribution, and marketing company and the owner of Hinode, a brand created by the California-based Rice Growers Association in the 1930s. Based in California's Central Valley, where rice has been grown for over 100 years, Hinode works with international partners in rice-growing regions around the world to offer a full range of domestic and imported varieties, and the brand is growing significantly. SunFoods is guided by values of integrity, collaboration, innovation, and community, and holds itself to doing the "hard right" over the "easy wrong" in how it treats people, serves customers, and shows up in its communities.

**What You Will Do**

In this role, you'll lead the Customer Service function across SunFoods' domestic and international business, owning the full order lifecycle from placement through fulfillment. You'll be the person who keeps customer, order, and shipment data accurate across systems, resolves escalations before they become bigger problems, and works across Sales, Planning, Operations, Logistics, and Finance to keep the business moving.

**Responsibilities:**

- Lead the Customer Service function across domestic, import, and export operations, owning the end-to-end order lifecycle
- Lead and develop a team of three, building service quality, accountability, and performance
- Ensure the accuracy and integrity of customer, order, and shipment data across business systems
- Own customer and consumer issue resolution, including escalation management and clear communication
- Establish and maintain Customer Service processes, controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks
- Drive continuous improvement, automation, and system enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability

**Who You Are**

You're a Customer Service or Supply Chain leader who's comfortable owning the full order lifecycle, not just handling escalations as they come in. You bring solid systems fluency, sound judgment on international trade and compliance requirements, and the leadership skills to coach a team while building better processes as the business grows.

**Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations leadership
- Solid understanding of both domestic and international customer service, order management, and supply chain processes
- Experience with SAP or similar business systems
- Working knowledge of international trade regulations, customs procedures, import/export documentation, and Incoterms
- Proven leadership, coaching, and team development skills, with clear communication and sound analytical judgment
- Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field
- Preferred: Experience with EDI integration and customer connectivity solutions
- Preferred: Background in food manufacturing or FMCG

**Benefits**

Base salary range $100-110k

10% Bonus potential

Medical, Dental, Vision options

401(k) and company match

Other insurance offerings

PTO and paid holidays
